name: Siberian water-milfoil
desc: Siberian water-milfoil (Myriophyllum sibiricum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Myriophyllum sibiricum is a species of water milfoil known by the common names shortspike watermilfoil, northern watermilfoil, and Siberian water-milfoil.
